[Intro]
[C]

[Verse 1]
[Em]I look up from the ground To see your
[C]sad and teary eyes You look a-
[G]way from me And I see there's
[D]something you're trying hide And I
[Em]reach for your hand but it's cold
[C]You pull away again And I
[G]wonder what's on your
[D]mind

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]And then you say to me you
[Em]made a dumb mistake
[D]You start to tremble and your
voice begins to break You say
[C]the cigarettes on the counter weren't your
[Em]friends They were my mates And I
[D]feel the color draining from my
face
And my friend said

[Chorus]
[Em]"I know you love her, but it's
[C]over, mate
[G]It doesn't matter, put the
[D]phone away
[Em]It's never easy to
[C]walk away, let her
[G]go
[D]It'll be alright

[Verse 2]
[Em]So I asked to look back at all the
[C]messages you'd sent And I
[G]know it wasn't right, but it was
[D]fucking with my head
[Em]And everything deleted like the
[C]past, it was gone And
[G]when I touched your face, I could
[D]tell you're moving on

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]But it's not the fact that you
[Em]kissed him yesterday It's the
[D]feeling of betrayal, that I
just can't seem to shake And
[C]everything I know tells me that
[Em]I should walk away But I
[D]just want to stay
And my friend said

[Chorus]
[Em]"I know you love her, but it's

[C]bit of time

[D]get tonight
[Em]You'll find another and you'll
[C]be just fine Let her
[G]go"
[D]
